name: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings
summary: Ategrity Specialty Holdings LLC, along with its subsidiaries, offers insurance and reinsurance services specifically designed for small and medium-sized businesses across the United States. Its product line primarily focuses on property and casualty insurance. The company was founded in 2017 and maintains its headquarters in New York, New York. Ategrity Specialty Holdings LLC operates as a subsidiary of Zimmer Financial Services Group LLC.
